app_tagline: Manage your supermarket and market shopping
app_footer: What are you buying? Your shopping list, for the supermarket and the market.
landing_step_family_text: One account and one family: the shared space where your shopping lives.
landing_step_invite_text: By email, with an invitation link; whoever joins comes in as a member.
landing_step_items_text: Items with quantity and units: check each one off as it goes into the cart.
landing_step_finalize_text: With the ticket total: purchased items move to the family pantry.
landing_feature_lists_text: With a name, color and icon; each item with its quantity and units.
landing_feature_family_text: Email invitations and admin and member roles: everyone sees the same thing.
landing_feature_checkout_text: When you finalize, you enter the total: it is recorded with the purchase.
landing_feature_pantry_text: Purchased items move in on their own: consume, restock and re-add what runs out.
landing_feature_history_text: Every purchase with its total and its items, always at hand.
landing_feature_i18n_text: The whole app in Spanish and English, designed to be used from your phone.
landing_cta_text: Create your family and share your first list today.
